slots.title: Session 1 — Baseline & hair cortisol
slots.introText: There are occasional minor and major challenges in daily life that can constantly reoccur, to which one can sometimes not get used to, and which can be more or less burdensome. Please tick whether and how strongly you have been affected by the following annoyances or inconveniences OVER THE PAST MONTH.

questions.text: Section 1 — Daily life stressors (past month)
A major life stressor (e.g. loss of a loved one, getting fired, moving house)
Health problems (e.g. diseases, chronic conditions)
Financial restrictions (e.g. low income, installments)
Dissatisfaction with education/occupation (e.g. examinations, work overload)
Difficulties with (secondary) employment (e.g. compatibility with school/college, high responsibility, noise pollution)
Dissatisfaction with housing situation (e.g. noise, small flat)
Frequent conflicts with close persons (family, household, friends, partner)
Frequent conflicts with other persons (colleagues, fellow students, neighbours)
Difficulties with social obligations (e.g. associations, organisations)
Another burden/stressor not yet mentioned

Section 2 — Emotion regulation (ERSS)
When something happens that makes me feel an emotion that I want to change, I manage how I am feeling by trying to…
Think about the situation differently
Shift what I am thinking about to something different
Accept the experience
Not show how I feel
Think of solutions to the event that caused the emotion
Relax my muscles
Capture and hold on to the emotion I am feeling at the moment
Repeatedly analyze the situation that made me feel this way

Section 3 — Thoughts after unpleasant situations (CERQ)
In unpleasant, stressful, or threatening situations…
I feel that I am the one who is responsible for what has happened
I keep thinking about how terrible it is what I have experienced
I feel that others are responsible for what has happened

Section 4 — Health consciousness (HCS)
The questions in this section ask you how important your health is in day-to-day life. We are interested in how much your health influences the choices you make every day.
In the past month… I was generally attentive to my inner feelings about my health
In the past month… I reflected about my health
In the past month… I noticed how I felt physically as I went through the day

slots.title: End questionnaire — intervention interest, demographics, sleep & substance use
slots.introText: People often encounter stressful situations in everyday life, but they are not always easy to manage effectively. As part of another study from our research team, we are offering you the opportunity to sign up for a brief online program after Lowlands designed to help you cope with everyday stress more effectively.

questions.text:
Section 1 — 5-day stress-management program (after Lowlands)
For five consecutive days, you will receive a short daily questionnaire. You will reflect on a stressful experience you have had, how you responded, and what you might do differently in the future. At the end of the 5-day program, you will receive a summary of your reflections. You will then be guided through developing a personalised action plan for managing similar situations the following week or in the future. The online program will take place one week after Lowlands.
Participating in this program is attractive to me
Participating in this program would be helpful for me to manage daily stress
People important to me would approve of me doing this program
Most people who matter to me would think participating in this program is a good idea
People similar to me would participate in this program
I am confident that I could participate in this program
Participating in this program would be easy for me
Can we use your email address to contact you after Lowlands with more information about this program?
I intend to participate in this program/intervention
Could you expand on why you do or do not wish to participate?
